# Tomdieu Ivan — Senior Full Stack Software Engineer

> Full Stack Software Developer based in Yaoundé, Cameroon. Specializes in Django, React, and Next.js. Builds scalable, production-ready web and mobile applications. Master's degree in Computer Science from University of Yaoundé 1.

## What I Do

I architect and build end-to-end digital products — from backend APIs and database design to responsive frontends and deployment. I work across Django, React, Next.js, and modern cloud infrastructure.

## Technical Expertise

- **Backend:** Django, Django REST Framework, Python, Node.js, RESTful API design, Celery, Redis
- **Frontend:** React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **DevOps:** Docker, Docker Compose, CI/CD, Linux server administration
- **Database:** PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB

## Key Projects

- **JoyFund** — Mobile-first healthcare crowdfunding platform digitizing Cameroon's Njangi solidarity culture. Django + Next.js + MTN MoMo/Orange Money integration.
- **Fiducia** — Cloud-based digital trust book and notary SaaS platform for legal document management.
- **MamaBrave** — Mental health crisis intervention app for women, featuring anonymous help-seeking, safety planning, and community support.
- **Mentora** — Next.js-based e-learning platform with Stripe payments and multi-role dashboards.
- **Prestige Properties** — Real estate property listing platform with Django + Next.js.
- **Hestia** — AI-powered energy management system for monitoring and optimizing power usage.
- **Njangi** — Group savings and lending platform inspired by Cameroon's Njangi tradition.
